name: pocket-shell
description: Pocket Shell for Nintendo 3DS, iPod touch and desktop operating systems

scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && git submodule update --init && bun install --cwd vendor/pocketjs --frozen-lockfile && bun scripts/setup.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && bun run --cwd shells/3ds typecheck && bun run --cwd shells/ipod typecheck && bun run --cwd shells/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd shells/3ds test && bun run --cwd shells/ipod test && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:sim && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:wrap && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:text
scripts.check: bun run check:assets && bun run typecheck && bun run test
